includes: Cupping, hot stones, and aromatherapy included at no additional charge with membership sessions.
Personalized care tailored to body needs each session.
Dry brushing, custom aromatherapy, warm abdominal massage, hydrating foot reflexology included in Detox & Restore Massage.
blurb: Dragonfly Aura provides massage therapy and wellness services including deep tissue massage, cupping therapy, and seasonal specials. They offer a massage membership with a monthly 90-minute session and flexible care options. Services are tailored to individual needs and focus on relaxation, recovery, and mobility support.
extraNote: Membership sessions are non-refundable and intended for in-studio appointments. · Unused membership credits roll over for up to 6 months. · Membership may be frozen for $25/month preserving unused credits. · Membership may be canceled anytime; unused credits are forfeited upon cancellation. · At least 24 hours notice required for cancellations or rescheduling; late cancellations may incur fees. · Late arrivals may result in shortened sessions with full fees applied. · Studio located in Glendale, CO, with parking available nearby.
